name: full-all-step005
rationale: The initial FULL_KINETIC attempt stopped after 85 steps with best residual 0.00721941 at step 83 and less than ten percent envelope improvement over ten steps. The matched NH3 AE recovery with FULL_ALL and STEPSIZE 0.05 has descended from 0.06213443 to 1.978e-5 in nine steps; urea also improves. Test the same preconditioning change from the exact preserved final CO2 WFN. No Hamiltonian, grid or EPS_SCF change; the final WFN is not asserted to be the best-residual WFN.
